name: Clarks Inn Badami
location: Veerapulakeshi Circle, Badami Main Road, Badami 587201 — near the cave temples and Agastya Lake
why_special: Badami's most reliable mid-scale hotel — a 3-star Clarks Inn unit on the main road, walking distance from the Chalukya cave-temple complex and Agastya Lake. Clean, consistent rooms, an in-house restaurant and complimentary parking make it the go-to base for the Badami-Aihole-Pattadakal triangle.

name: KSTDC Hotel Mayura Chalukya Badami
location: Ramdurg Road, PWD Compound, Badami 587201 — 2.8 km from the cave temples, 1.3 km from the bus stand
why_special: The Karnataka State Tourism (KSTDC) government hotel for Badami — two blocks of AC and non-AC rooms set in a garden compound with a restaurant and beer parlour. Plain and inexpensive, it is the dependable budget-to-mid anchor for the Chalukya temple circuit and a fallback during the Banashankari festival rush.

name: Sterling Banashree Badami
location: Yaragoppa S.B, near Badami — a 10-acre garden resort on the approach to Badami town
why_special: A 4-star Sterling Holidays resort spread over 10 acres of greenery with an outdoor pool — the most resort-like stay in the Chalukya belt. Pitched as the gateway to the underrated Badami-Pattadakal-Aihole monuments, it suits travellers who want pool-and-garden comfort rather than a town hotel.

name: Hotel Badami Court
location: Station Road, Badami 587201 — a unit of Shreejit Resorts, with garden and pool
why_special: A long-running 4-star property in Badami with an outdoor pool, garden, shared terrace and 24-hour front desk. One of the older established hotels in town and a comfortable mid-range alternative to Clarks Inn for the cave-temple circuit.

name: Hotel Madhuvan International
location: Station Road, Vijayapura (Bijapur) 586101 — a 5-minute drive from Gol Gumbaz
why_special: Bijapur's best-regarded mid-scale hotel — 37 AC rooms with balconies, an in-house restaurant and a banquet garden, within walking-to-short-drive distance of Gol Gumbaz and the Adil Shahi monuments. Reliably clean rooms and 24-hour hot water make it the dependable city base for the Deccan-sultanate circuit.

name: KSTDC Hotel Mayura Adil Shahi Vijayapura
location: Anand Mahal Road, Vijayapura (Bijapur) — the Karnataka tourism hotel near the Adil Shahi monument zone
why_special: The KSTDC government hotel for Bijapur — a plain, inexpensive state-run property named for the Adil Shahi dynasty whose monuments (Gol Gumbaz, Ibrahim Rauza, Bara Kaman) define the city. The budget anchor for heritage travellers who want a no-frills, centrally placed base.

name: Hotel Pearl
location: Station Road, near the post office, Vijayapura (Bijapur) 586101 — a 5-minute walk from Gol Gumbaz
why_special: A casual, well-located hotel a five-minute walk from the Gol Gumbaz mausoleum and a short walk from the railway station — the closest reasonable rooms to Bijapur's signature monument. Reasonable rates and a workable budget-to-mid option for a short heritage stop.

name: Krishna Regency Hotel
location: Near the Bus Stand, Bidar 585401 — central, close to the fort and Bahmani monuments
why_special: One of Bidar's most established town hotels, centrally placed near the bus stand within easy reach of Bidar Fort, Rangeen Mahal and the Bahmani tombs. A reliable, plain mid-range base in a town that has limited quality accommodation.

name: Hotel Mayura Bidar
location: Udgir Road, Bidar 585401 — opposite the new bus stand
why_special: A budget 3-star town hotel opposite the new bus stand, close to Bidar Fort, Rangeen Mahal and the Solah Khambha Masjid. Basic rooms with the standard amenities and free parking — a workable, centrally located base for exploring the Bahmani capital. (Note: a privately run lodge, not a KSTDC property despite the Mayura name.)

name: Kyriad Hotel Gulbarga by OTHPL
location: Kalaburagi (Gulbarga) — a business hotel about 12 km from Kalaburagi Airport
why_special: Gulbarga's most reliable branded hotel — a Kyriad-branded business property with 43 AC rooms, an in-house restaurant, room service and a 24-hour front desk. The dependable mid-scale base for the Bahmani-fort and Sufi-dargah city, where quality accommodation is otherwise thin.

name: The Oaks Elite
location: Kalaburagi (Gulbarga) — a city hotel with a bar and terrace
why_special: A 3-star Kalaburagi city hotel with AC rooms, a bar and a terrace — a solid value alternative to the Kyriad for travellers visiting Gulbarga Fort, the Sharana Basaveshwara temple and the Khwaja Bande Nawaz dargah.

name: KSTDC Hotel Mayura Velapuri Belur
location: Temple Road, Belur 573115, Hassan District — a 5-minute walk from the Chennakeshava temple complex
why_special: The KSTDC government hotel for Belur — 14 rooms including a suite, AC and non-AC options and two dormitories, plus a restaurant and bar, all a five-minute walk from the Chennakeshava temple. The single best-located stay for travellers who want to linger over the Hoysala carvings at first light.

name: KSTDC Hotel Mayura Yagachi
location: Yagachi Dam, Belur Taluk, Hassan District — facing the Yagachi reservoir, ~10 km from Belur town
why_special: A KSTDC government property set right opposite the Yagachi Dam, with cool reservoir breezes and water views — a quieter, scenic alternative to a town hotel, within driving distance of Belur, Halebidu, Chikmagalur and Hassan. A water-sports point in season.

name: KSTDC Hotel Mayura Shantala Halebidu
location: Halebidu 573121, Hassan District — almost next door to the Hoysaleswara temple
why_special: The KSTDC government hotel for Halebidu — a compact property (3 AC double rooms and a four-bed room) located almost next door to the Hoysaleswara temple, with a restaurant serving Karnataka cuisine. The only real stay in the village itself; otherwise Hassan (~30 km) is the base.

name: Java Rain Resorts
location: Mullayanagiri foothills, Chikmagalur — a 25-villa resort in an active coffee plantation
why_special: A 25-villa luxury resort tucked into a working coffee plantation on the Mullayanagiri hills, with panoramic views over the Baba Budan range and Chikmagalur town. Spacious, stylish villas and a serene plantation setting make it one of the district's top-rated luxury stays.

name: Machaan Plantation Resort
location: Sakleshpur 573134, Hassan District — a coffee-plantation resort amid hillocks and paddy fields
why_special: Sakleshpur's top-rated resort (Tripadvisor #1 of 9) — 16 AC rooms set inside a working coffee plantation surrounded by hillocks and paddy fields, with an outdoor pool, large gardens and rolling-hill views. The standout leisure base in the Western Ghats coffee belt.

name: Hyatt Place Hampi
location: Hospet (Vijayanagara district) — a 134-room hotel a short drive from the Hampi ruins
why_special: The only internationally branded full-service hotel serving Hampi — 134 contemporary rooms with a pool, set near Narihalla on the Hospet side. The reliable modern-comfort base for travellers who want air-conditioned consistency rather than a heritage resort or riverside guesthouse.

name: Kishkinda Heritage Resort
location: Near Stone Bridge cross, within 3 km of the Virupaksha Temple, Hampi
why_special: A long-running 3-star heritage-style resort within 3 km of the Virupaksha temple — over a decade in the hospitality trade, with a rock-garden setting that gives it its 'King of Rock Garden' nickname. A mid-range option closer to the monuments than the Hospet hotels.

name: KSTDC Hotel Mayura Durg Chitradurga
location: Opposite Chitradurga Fort, next to Maharani College, Chitradurga 577501
why_special: The KSTDC government hotel for Chitradurga — 8 AC rooms and 4 eight-bed dormitories with a restaurant, garden and sun terrace, located directly opposite the Chitradurga Fort and within walking distance of its entrance. The single best-located stay for the fort and a reliable highway-town base.

name: Bandipur Safari Lodge (Jungle Lodges & Resorts)
location: Bandipur, Chamarajanagar District — the JLR government wildlife lodge at Bandipur Tiger Reserve
why_special: The Karnataka government's Jungle Lodges & Resorts property at Bandipur — a contemporary-style lodge run as a joint venture with the state, with spacious rooms, naturalist-led safaris and forest views. The authoritative, conservation-aligned base for the Bandipur Tiger Reserve.

name: Dhole's Den
location: Village edge bordering Bandipur National Park, Chamarajanagar District
why_special: A boutique eco-homestay on the village fringe of Bandipur — just 5 units (2 rooms, a suite, 2 bungalows), an organic farm, wind and solar power and a biodiversity garden. Campfires, nature walks, tribal-village visits and safaris make it the intimate, sustainable alternative to the larger lodges.

name: MC Resort Bandipur
location: Bandipur, Chamarajanagar District — a jungle-safari resort near Bandipur National Park
why_special: A comfortable jungle-safari resort near Bandipur National Park with full amenities — a mid-to-upper-range private alternative to the government JLR lodge, arranging guided safaris and plush rooms for families and couples on a Bandipur wildlife break.

name: The Bison Resort
location: Kabini backwaters, overlooking the Nagarhole & Bandipur Tiger Reserve, Kodagu District
why_special: The only property on the Kabini backwaters that directly overlooks the Nagarhole and Bandipur reserves — African-style luxury safari tents with an observation deck of binoculars and telescopes for spotting elephants across the river. A genuine wildlife-immersion lodge on the Nagarhole fringe.

name: Whistling Woodzs
location: On the banks of the Kali River, Dandeli, Uttara Kannada District
why_special: Dandeli's best-known riverside resort — premium cottages on the Kali River within tropical rainforest, with white-water rafting, kayaking and jungle activities arranged on site. A high-recommendation property and the leading private base for a Dandeli adventure break.

name: Stone Wood Jungle Resort
location: Dandeli, Uttara Kannada District — a jungle resort with a pool near the Kali River
why_special: A well-rated jungle resort in Dandeli with a swimming pool and comfortable rooms — a solid mid-range alternative to Whistling Woodzs for travellers combining a Kali River adventure with pool-and-resort comfort.

name: Lalitha Mahal Palace Hotel
location: Siddhartha Nagar, Mysuru — the second-largest palace in Mysore, on a hill east of the city
why_special: A 1921 palace built by the Maharaja of Mysore to host the Viceroy of India, now a government heritage hotel — Renaissance architecture, Italian marble, Venetian chandeliers and a grand central dome. The most atmospheric heritage stay in Mysore, set on its own hill with palace views.

name: Radisson Blu Plaza Hotel Mysore
location: Overlooking the Mysore race course, Mysuru — a full-service 5-star near the city's attractions
why_special: A modern 5-star hotel overlooking the Mysore race course, close to the palace and the city's main attractions — pool, spa and multiple restaurants. The reliable contemporary-comfort alternative for travellers who want full-service consistency rather than a heritage property.

name: KSTDC Hotel Mayura Riverview Srirangapatna
location: Mysore Road, on the banks of the Cauvery, Srirangapatna 571438 — 3.4 km from Ranganathittu Bird Sanctuary
why_special: The KSTDC government hotel for Srirangapatna — 26 cosy rooms including 6 river-facing cottages on the banks of the Cauvery, with a multi-cuisine restaurant, bar and coracle rides on the river. The standout location stay for Tipu Sultan's island capital and the nearby bird sanctuary.

name: The Windflower Prakruthi Resort & Spa
location: Bengaluru northern outskirts toward Nandi Hills — ~7 km from Chikkajala Fort, ~35 min from the city
why_special: A 49-room resort and spa across 3 hectares on the Bengaluru-Nandi Hills corridor, with independent villas, wellness treatments and gardens — the most established resort stay for a Nandi Hills sunrise trip, an easy drive from both the airport and the city.

name: Devbagh Beach Resort (Jungle Lodges & Resorts)
location: Devbagh Island, on a peninsula in the Kali River estuary, Karwar — opposite Kodibag Post Office
why_special: The Karnataka government's Jungle Lodges & Resorts beach property — rustic log huts and thatched cottages, some on stilts, on a mangrove-fringed peninsula with a private beach. Dolphin-watching and meals are included; Tripadvisor's #2 of 13 in Karwar. The authoritative, conservation-aligned coastal base.

name: RNS Residency Sea View
location: Murudeshwar 581350, Uttara Kannada District — less than a 5-minute walk from both the Shiva temple and the beach
why_special: Murudeshwar's flagship beach-side hotel, run by the RNS/Naveen group — family rooms, a garden, terrace and outdoor pool, a 2-minute walk from Murudeshwar Beach and minutes from the towering Shiva statue and temple. The most reliable comfortable base in this temple-and-beach town.

name: The Ocean Pearl
location: Navabharath Circle, Mangaluru 575003 — central, ~1.6 km from Mangalore Central railway station
why_special: A well-rated central Mangalore hotel known for its breakfast — four dining options, a fitness centre, free parking and Wi-Fi, a short distance from the railway station and ~14 km from the airport. The dependable city-centre business-and-leisure base for coastal Karnataka's main port city.

name: Goldfinch Hotel Mangalore
location: Bunts Hostel Road, Mangaluru — central, a short walk from transport links
why_special: A central Mangalore hotel in the heart of the city with three dining options and modern guestrooms — a comfortable, well-connected mid-scale choice for travellers who want to be in the city core close to shopping and transport.

name: Paradise Isle Beach Resort
location: Malpe Beach, Udupi 576103 — ~5 km from the Udupi temple town, on the beach
why_special: A 75-room 4-star beach resort on Malpe Beach near Udupi — three restaurants, a swimming pool, an Ayurveda spa and water sports, with direct beach access and the St Mary's Island boat jetty close by. The main full-service resort for the Udupi-Malpe coast.

name: Country Inn & Suites by Radisson, Manipal
location: Manipal (Udupi District) — a branded hotel in the university town adjacent to Udupi
why_special: A modern Radisson-brand hotel in Manipal, the university town next to Udupi — a marina, gym, outdoor pool and restaurant, with welcoming contemporary rooms. The reliable branded-comfort alternative to a beach resort for the Udupi area.

name: Sri Manjunatha Temple Guest Houses (Dharmasthala Temple Trust)
location: Dharmasthala 574216, Dakshina Kannada District — temple-trust guest-house complexes within walking distance of the Manjunatha Swamy temple
why_special: The official pilgrim accommodation run by the Dharmasthala Temple Trust — a network of guest houses (Netravathi, Rajathadri, Sannidhi, Gangotri, Sharavathi and others), most within walking distance of the temple, with clean family rooms, attached bathrooms and 24/7 security. Tariffs are far below private hotels; book only via the official temple website.

name: Kukke Subramanya Devasthana Guest Houses
location: Subramanya 574238, Dakshina Kannada District — temple-trust guest houses within 200-800 m of the Subramanya Swamy temple
why_special: The official pilgrim accommodation run by the Kukke Sri Subrahmanya Temple Administration — guest houses and rest houses (including Ashlesha, Kumaradhara and Sahasra Shree) within a short walk of the temple, with attached bathrooms, clean linen and 24-hour water. Inexpensive and the authentic base for the Sarpa Samskara serpent-ritual pilgrimage; book via the temple eSeva portal.

name: KSTDC Hotel Mayura Gerusoppa Jog Falls
location: Jog Falls, Sagara Taluk, Shivamogga District — a 15-minute walk from the falls viewpoint
why_special: The KSTDC government hotel for Jog Falls — 20 rooms (AC deluxe, semi-AC and non-AC) in the Tunga Block, with a restaurant, parking and falls views, a 15-minute walk from the Jog Falls and Rani Falls viewpoints. The closest reliable stay to India's second-highest plunge waterfall.

name: Sharavathi Adventure Camp (Jungle Lodges & Resorts)
location: Sharavathi backwaters, ~6 km from Jog Falls — on a hillock skirting the Talakalale Reservoir, Shivamogga District
why_special: The Karnataka government's Jungle Lodges & Resorts eco-camp on the Sharavathi backwaters near Jog Falls — tents and cottages amid forest and rolling hills by the Linganamakki Dam reservoir, with coracle rides, kayaking, birding and trekking. Tripadvisor #1 of 2 Jog specialty lodgings.
